headline: Tencent scientist warns AI biology skills near a harm threshold
body: A quieter Saturday. Tencent's chief AI scientist warned that AI biology skills are near a 'can do harm' threshold, and Google DeepMind said AI found new weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA. Both raised Catastrophic Risk, which rose 0.33. OpenAI closed an $11 billion first tranche at a $1.25 trillion valuation, below its earlier target, nudging Power Concentration up. Self-Destruction rose and the two utopias slipped. Horizon Balance fell to -18.49 from -18.23.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.39, from the Tencent warning (+0.26) and the RSA finding (+0.12). Libertarian Utopia -0.23, mainly from the Tencent warning (-0.12). Egalitarian Utopia -0.17, mainly from the Tencent warning (-0.10).
